print.name: WLToys K989 Monster truck wheel
print.description:
Give extra clearance to your K989 with this 50mm wheels. Also increase track width to 102mm.

Rim are compatible with 43.2x22 lego tires.

This is not compatible with the default body shell, the wheels rub on it when you turn.

Rims are in PLA, tires in filaflex 82A.

It uses the same bolts as the original wheels but you will need a long tool to tighten the bolt.
